concept: Building a consistent training habit around a physical goal that matters to you
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Leonidas's discipline-and-training tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student sets a realistic physical goal (a sport, a fitness milestone, a skill) and plans a training routine around real-life constraints
exercise.branching_choice: Student adjusts the plan when a realistic obstacle (injury risk, time conflict) arises
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on how to stay consistent without overtraining or burning out

assessment.success_marker: student proposes a sustainable plan, not an unrealistic all-or-nothing routine
